verses.sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वभूतानामात्मा सर्वगतः सदा ।
मामेव सर्वभूतेषु पश्यन् सर्वत्र मुच्यते ॥
verses.translation: I am indeed the Self of all beings, ever all-pervading. Seeing Me in all beings everywhere, one is liberated.

verses.sanskrit:
मां ये प्रपद्यन्ते भक्त्या ते मां नात्येति माययी ।
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ॥
verses.translation: Those who surrender unto Me with devotion are not overcome by My Maya. This divine Maya of Mine, consisting of the three gunas, is very difficult to overcome.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मणो यत् पराभवः ।
एतत्कृत्वोपसन्ध्यार्त मोक्षमास्थापयेन्नरः ॥
verses.translation: Knowledge, realized wisdom, and faith in Brahman that transcends the material — by practicing these at the junctions of the day, one should establish oneself in liberation.

chapters.title: The Path of Yoga and Meditation

verses.sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा महेश्वरे ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
verses.translation: Established in yoga, perform actions surrendering attachment to Maheshvara. Being equal in success and failure — that equanimity is called yoga.

verses.sanskrit:
मन एव मनुष्याणां कारणं बन्धमोक्षयोः ।
बन्धाय विषयासक्तं मुक्त्यै निर्विषयं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.translation: The mind alone is the cause of bondage and liberation for human beings. Attached to sense objects it leads to bondage; free from sense objects it leads to liberation.
